C9000268.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 268 (The spin-one Haldane gap.; papers: The periodic spin-one Haldane gap; A boundary-field gap for the spin-one Heisenberg chain; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PERIODIC_MAIN.statement: Periodic thm:main: uniqueness for even L >= 60, gap > (4/105) log(80/79) there, and gap > log(20)/784 for even L >= 2304.

C_BOUNDARY_MAIN.statement: Boundary thm:main: the same-field open chain has gap > log(10)/392 for every L >= 960, with n = 2L+1 and h = 3/5.

C_TRANSFER.statement: The specified chronological kernel gives both literal periodic and open-chain transfer identities at every stated parameter, not only at finitely tested orders.

C_TRANSFER_CORE.statement: For an arbitrary finite ordered event word, the trace of the product of sitewise tensor matrices is the product of the chronological local word traces; identity insertions may be filtered without reversing order.

C_HISTORY_INTERLEAVING.statement: For every finite tuple of history lengths, the product of ordered time simplexes decomposes, up to collision null sets, into the global ordered simplexes indexed by order-preserving interleavings, with Jacobian one.

C_TRANSFER_ANALYTIC.statement: The history kernel is measurable, real, symmetric, bounded by 3 on a space of mass exp(3b); the stated Hilbert--Schmidt, trace-class, absolute-convergence, and cycle-trace assertions follow.

C_TRANSFER_PERIODIC.statement: Periodic prop:transfer: Z_n(b,g) = Tr(X_b^n U_g) for all b > 0, n >= 4, and all 24 proper signed permutations, with the seam conjugated on site 0 and shift a = 700741/500000 per site.

C_TRANSFER_BOUNDARY.statement: Boundary tr:boundary: for all b > 0, n >= 2, and g in the stated twelve-element group, <v_b, X_b^n U_g v_b> is the open-chain partition function with left field -h S_0^z and right field +h S_{n-1}^{g e_z}; h = 3/5 and the shift is per site.

C_PERIODIC_FINITE.statement: The periodic finite thermal, variational, and scalar initialization certificates establish the exact seeds required in build/initialization.tex.

C_PERIODIC_PROPAGATION.statement: The periodic rotation-sector, purity bootstrap, length coverage, and gap-extraction arguments propagate the stated seeds to the periodic main theorem.

C_BOUNDARY_FINITE.statement: The boundary finite thermal, trial, and scalar initialization certificates establish the seeds for the stated endpoint Hamiltonians.

C_BOUNDARY_PROPAGATION.statement: The boundary recurrence, leading-line invariance, signed odd-length comparison, and gap extraction propagate the exact seeds to the boundary main theorem.
